journal.restless.bestiary.poltergeist:
Poltergeist

Noisy and restless. Doors, chests, things that move on their own. Rarely hurts, at first.
journal.restless.bestiary.shade:
Shade

Quiet and heavy. Puts out the lights, whispers, wears you down. Turns cruel with time.
journal.restless.bestiary.phantom:
Phantom

Wants to be seen, as someone living: a stranger far off, a name that is not there. Seldom hurts.
journal.restless.bestiary.nix:
Nix

Bound to water. Keeps swimmers under, calls you to the shore, breaks boats.
journal.restless.bestiary.mimic:
Mimic

Fakes things: blocks that are not there, strangers, beasts that vanish.
journal.restless.bestiary.wraith:
Wraith

Hunts in the dark. Snuffs your light first, then comes closer.
journal.restless.bestiary.mara:
Mara

Rides the sleeper. Worse at night, and worst in bed.
journal.restless.bestiary.banshee:
Banshee

A voice. Mostly sounds; it hardly touches anything.
journal.restless.bestiary.revenant:
Revenant

Vengeful. Hurts and sends beasts, and it remembers every kill.
journal.restless.bestiary.lost_one:
Lost one

Wanders. Figures, footsteps, strangers. Follows you down into the deep.
journal.restless.bestiary.domovoi:
Domovoi

Keeps to a house. Doors, belongings, household noises. Hardly harmful.
journal.restless.bestiary.hoarder:
Hoarder

Keeps to one place and takes what is left lying there.
journal.restless.bestiary.demon:
Demon

Keeps to one place, and it is dangerous: it strikes, sickens and sends beasts.
journal.restless.bestiary.trickster:
Trickster

Keeps to one place and plays pranks: blocks and things that change, sights that are not there.
journal.restless.guide.start.title: To whoever reads this
journal.restless.guide.start.1: If you found this, they have found you too. The dead do not rest here. Some follow a living soul, some keep to one place.
journal.restless.guide.start.2: They start weak and grow with every day left alone. I wrote down what I learned. Keep writing: this book fills itself as you notice things.
journal.restless.guide.haunted.title: Signs
journal.restless.guide.haunted.1: A door slamming by itself, a torch gone out, steps where nobody walks. That is them, and they will not stop.
journal.restless.guide.haunted.2: A spirit candle leans toward whoever moves next and burns blue just before. A spirit compass points to the nearest. A closed ring of salt keeps them off you.
journal.restless.guide.haunted.3: To learn what haunts you, lay ash and wait, photograph the dark with a camera obscura, speak near a spirit box, ask an ouija board. Each tool shows only some of them.
journal.restless.guide.clues.title: Reading clues
journal.restless.guide.clues.1: No two spirits are alike. A clue shows one of its ways, never all. Gather several before you decide anything.
journal.restless.guide.clues.2: A photograph and a print in ash never lie. Some spirits lie through the spirit box and the board. The same print is always the same spirit.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.title: The altar
journal.restless.guide.weakness.1: Every spirit shrinks from something: iron, glowstone, holy water or a mirror. Each of its ways leans one way, and most of them win. One photo is not enough.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.2: Build an altar, light four candles on it and close a ring of salt around it. Lay the right focus on it and the spirit comes.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.3: It will fight: snuff the candles, strike at you. Relight them and stay close until it is over. The wrong focus only feeds its fury.
journal.restless.guide.graves.title: Unfinished business
journal.restless.guide.graves.1: Every spirit was someone. Its grave lies a few hundred blocks off. The stone says who they were and what they lost.
journal.restless.guide.graves.2: Bring back what they want and they rest, kinder than any ritual. When your mind frays, the spirit box tells where the bones lie.
journal.restless.guide.sanity.title: The dark at the edges
journal.restless.guide.sanity.1: Darkness, haunted ground and every fright wear you down. Light, food, sleep and salt bring you back.
journal.restless.guide.sanity.2: A shaken mind hears more than a calm one. Not all of it is worth wanting.
journal.restless.guide.evolution.title: Left alone
journal.restless.guide.evolution.1: A spirit left alone too long grows into something worse, for good. The land around some of them turns grey.
journal.restless.guide.evolution.2: Do not wait. Once it is banished or at rest, the land heals.
journal.restless.guide.essence.title: What remains
journal.restless.guide.essence.1: Some spirits leave an essence behind. A ritual gives one; a grave set right gives more.
journal.restless.guide.essence.2: Essence can be worked into charms. A poltergeist's pulls dropped things to you; a shade's lets you see in the dark.
